column1: # Passages that Nestle's Greek New Testament of 1904 (British and Foreign Bible Society) prints set apart, read from the page images
# (archive.org/details/biblentgreektext00nestuoft; printed page = leaf - 11) on 2026-11-12. A reviewed, frozen table: do not derive it by rule.
# class: lines = poetic lines, not a quotation from the Scriptures; block = a narrower block; qlines = poetic lines quoted from the Scriptures.
# start/end: chapter:verse, with a = the verse's first part only, b = from inside the verse. lines = printed lines (turnovers not counted).
# leaf = the scan's leaf where it was seen; unit = its row in the check (internal-docs). Not a full pass through the book: about 155 of 668 pages were viewed.
